title: Role immersion micro rituals and day-one sensory checklist
content:
Purpose:
A compact, operational playbook to make the first 90 days feel intentional for new hires across engineering and product pods. Emphasis on micro-rituals (small repeatable behaviors) and a sensory checklist for Day 0/1 to reduce cognitive load and friction. Draft — notes, TODOs, and loose timelines below.

Scope and audience:
- Applicable to IC and manager hires across eng, product, DX, and SRE where role immersion matters (not for contractor brief gigs).
- Primary owners: people-ops (Aisha), hiring manager, onboarding buddy.

High-level hiring plan snapshot (compact):
- Week -4 to -2 (requisition -> shortlist): define immersion outcomes (3 signals of success in 30/60/90 days) + shortlist criteria (skills + ecosystem fit).
- Week -1 (offer -> preboard): send role immersion brief, access checklist, and micro-prework (30–45 min).
- Day 0–1: sensory checklist + buddy meet + set first small win (ship a doc/update).
- Day 2–14: micro-rituals kickoff, 1:1 cadence established, 7-day knowledge snapshot.
- Day 30/60/90: signal check-ins and evidence capture (candidate-generated artifact).

Interview rubric: compact version for loopers
- Problem decomposition (0–4): can break ambiguous problems into next steps + quick constraints.
- Product judgement (0–4): tradeoffs, user impact, metrics clarity.
- Systems competence or coding fluency (0–4): depends on role; score against role-specific probes.
- Collaboration (0–3): communicates clearly, asks clarifying Qs, invites feedback.
- Role-readiness signals (0–2): prior experience with similar stack or patterns.
- Evidence weight: aim to capture 2–3 concrete artifacts per candidate (PRs, design doc, runbook).
Notes to interviewers: prefer 20m demo + 25m probe + 10m calibration. Capture explicit red/green examples in comments.

Day 0/1 sensory checklist (minimal, prioritized):
- Device: laptop arrived and bootable (admin account), charger, power adapter mapped (if remote, confirm UPS/desk setup).
- Access: corp email created, SSO to internal apps, GitHub access, CI badge, Slack + team channels, calendar invites for 1:1s and onboarding rituals
- Workspace signals: preferred editor themes, shortcuts doc, recommended terminal config (link), key infra endpoints (staging URL, docs home)
- Communication script: 3x intro templates (Slack intro, cross-team note, manager welcome script)
- First small win (assigned within 24h): triage doc or small doc edit + PR template filled
- Safety & ergonomics: headset, webcam test, camera background guidance, chair/monitor stipend process link

Micro-rituals (repeatables to seed role culture):
- Monday 15m standup shadow: new hire attends one cross-team standup as observer + notes a single improvement idea.
- Tuesdays: 30m buddy office hours (weekly, 6 weeks). Buddy prepares 3 artifacts to explain the subsystem.
- Week-of demo: new hire prepares a 5-slide "what I learned" at end of week 1 and shares in team channel.
- End-of-week sync: quick async pulse (3 things learned, 1 blocker, 1 ask) posted to #new-hires channel.
- 30-day artifact: new hire owns a short one-pager describing a small improvement hypothesis with next steps.

Asynchronous preboard kit (what to send immediately after offer accepted):
- Role immersion brief (2 pages): outcomes, 30/60/90 signals, three artifacts to review prior to start.
- Access checklist (tick boxes) and contact map (who to ping for infra, HR, payroll).
- 45-min prework: optional repo read guide + short setup video (hosted internally).
- Quick wins ideas list (3–5 low-risk tasks) — pick one to attempt in first 72h.

Buddy schedule (template):
- Day 0: 30m buddy intro, context and tour.
- Day 1–5: 30m daily drop-in.
- Week 2–4: 60m weekly deep-dive.
- Month 2–3: biweekly check-ins to help with scope and networking.

Signals of success (concrete, for hiring manager + people-ops):
- Day 7: completed one small win (PR/doc) and shared a 5-slide learning.
- Day 30: has a clear 30-day artifact and has shipped an improvement or written a runbook.
- Day 60: owns a feature or operational task and shows cross-team context.
- Day 90: measurable impact or a clear plan for the next quarter.

First-90 hiring plan checklist (operational items):
- Role outcomes defined
- Interview rubric calibrated (2 reviewers have run calibration session)
- Offer letter + preboard kit prepared
- Hardware + access ordered 2 weeks ahead
- Buddy assigned and calendar invites sent
- First-week schedule templated and shared
- Learning artifacts assigned and links in onboarding doc

Open questions / TODOs:
- How to reduce infra access lead time from 5 days -> 24h w/out compromising security? (action: engage infra SRE to propose a staging SSO flow)
- Hiring panel diversity checklist — add example call scripts for inclusive interviewing (Priya to draft)
- Metricizing micro-ritual adoption — what telemetry can we add to console? (tag: product-hosted-api)

Quick links and references:
- Onboard templates (Confluence): CONFLUENCE-hr/onboard-templates
- Offer and comp playbook: CONFLUENCE-people/comp-offer-guide
- HR ticket: JIRA-HR-4821
- Sample day-one schedule (Google Sheet): drive-sample-dayone

Notes to self (Aisha):
- Prototype this with one engineering hire in Dec. Track time-to-first-touch and completion of small-win.
- Build a short Loom for managers on the micro-rituals value prop (90s).
- Consider adding a "role immersion lab" slot to the Console docs for cross-functional discovery.

Appendix (templates to copy-paste):
- Slack intro template: "Heads up — join me in welcoming NAME, role X. They’ll be focused on Y. Drop a hello and a tip if you’ve worked on similar areas"
- 24h small-win checklist: 1) clone repo, 2) run tests, 3) find one TODO and propose small fix, 4) open PR with description.

Status: draft — want to iterate with Diego (learning ops), Priya (diversity hiring), and Samir (infra).
